PI ENGINE Tier 1

Pressure Index (PI) Formulation

Synthesizes match situation across required run rate (RRR), wicket clusters (crisis collapses ≤30/3), and late-innings leverage into a continuous metric \(PI_i \in [0, 100]\). Deliveries with \(PI_i \ge 50\) represent 39.0% of all balls.

WPA LOGISTIC AUC = 0.8966

Win Probability Added (WPA)

Trained on all 95,272 2nd-innings chasing deliveries to track delta win equity. First innings is evaluated via crisis and death par benchmarks. WPA rates use chase balls as denominator to avoid sample skew.

BAYESIAN & QUALITY k = 80 Balls

Shrinkage & Competition Scaling

Dampens small sample anomalies toward league prior means, and scales competition quality (IPL 1.00×, Tier-1 T20I 0.90×, Associate 0.75×) to prevent lower-league inflation.

Audit Finding: Exactly 16 scheduled matches had 0 balls bowled due to persistent inclement weather and wet outfields. These matches appear in the competition fixture schedule (matches.csv) with status Match Abandoned, but produce zero rows in ball_by_ball.csv.

Verification Equation: 883 Scheduled = 867 Contested + 16 Abandoned. All 200,999 deliveries in the dataset originate from the 867 contested matches.
